business_summary.text: Veedol Corporation Limited is a lubricant manufacturer and marketer with operations in India, Middle East, and UK. The company focuses on automotive and industrial lubricants under the Veedol brand, with a strategy of premiumization and international expansion.

call_points.text: No specific FY27 guidance provided, but management expects continued margin protection
Premiumization strategy compromised margins initially to gain market share, with corrections now in place
Current capacity utilization at 70%, no immediate capex plans needed
EV transition not seen as immediate threat to conventional lubricant demand in India

timeline.summary: On May 4, 2026, Veedol Corporation announced that Managing Director Arijit Basu resigned effective November 3, 2026.
On May 9, 2026, Veedol Corporation announced the receipt of an insurance claim repudiation letter from National Insurance Company for the Bhiwandi depot fire.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹606.98 Cr, net profit ₹57.46 Cr.
103rd AGM held on 24 August 2026, with MD appointment and FY26 results discussed
